summary: The pairwise ledger follows from the empty common-upper cases and planar Brunn--Minkowski in the nonempty case, with all boundary and zero-area cases handled correctly. The proposed scalar tuple satisfies the residual strip, all projected constraints, the endpoint-family scalar disjunction, and violates the target bound; the averaging lower bound proves its claimed exact projected optimum. The final common-upper calculation correctly shows why the tuple fails the stronger unprojected system.
